newsitem.title: INDIA: India IPCL sets 95/96 div at 4.0 rupees.
newsitem.headline: India IPCL sets 95/96 div at 4.0 rupees.

text.p: Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd (IPCL) recommended a dividend of four rupees per share for 1995/96 (April-March), the highest ever to be paid by the company, its chairman told shareholders on Wednesday.

"I am happy to inform you that the board of directors of your company have recommended a total dividend of 40 percent - the highest ever - for the year 1995/96," chairman K.G. Ramanathan told an annual shareholders meeting at the western city of Vadodara.
"After disbursement of dividend, the book value of your company's share will be close to 100 rupees against its last year's book value of over 79 rupees," he said.
